inv-overworld.text:
OVERWORLD HUD: every element of GameMenu.tsx and board.tsx has a place

Moved:
- Menu button + waiting count -> the trainer corner (bottom left), so the keypad grows out of it.
- Egg badge (top right) -> a progress ring round the trainer corner, plus its steps under the name.
- Gold (bar) -> under the name in the trainer corner.
- Place and weather button + popover -> a capsule at bottom centre that opens into a card in place; the windows become a grid of six.
- Field-move chips -> round buttons bottom right, where the thumb is.
- Fullscreen (bar) -> top-right corner, its usual place.
- Keypad tiles -> three labelled columns of rows (You, Play, Inbox), counts on the right; Settings and theme in its footer.

New (proposal): the trainer's name in the corner.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-sheet.text:
CATCH SHEET: every element of sheet.tsx and its sections has a place

Moved:
- Nameplate (name, species, gender, shiny) -> a hero header with the name large and the level as a tag.
- Portrait, chips, stars, sigil, HP and statuses -> the hero, beside the portrait.
- Tera type and candy + Level Up -> hero tiles on the right, the two things raised from here.
- Badges -> the hero; box chip and Actions -> top right with a close button.
- Stats -> left column, with a hexagon of the totals over the table (IV, EV inputs, Remaining, Undo, Save kept).
- Moves -> the centre as cards in a 3-wide grid, since they are what a player builds around; Abilities and Held items under them.
- Evolution -> right column as a vertical line with Evolve.
- Dock (ball, history line, History n, Close) -> an Origin card; Close -> the header.

New (proposal): the hexagon; move cards show type, category, power and PP.
Dropped: nothing. Shadow and In a raid badges appear when they apply.

inv-battle.text:
BATTLE: every element of the battle view, top bar, unit card and verdict has a place

Moved:
- Side meters -> your side top left, the foe mirrored top right, standing counts as ball pips.
- Title (or Replay, Awards nothing, speeds) -> a centre nameplate with the speeds under it.
- Leave -> bottom right, still confirmed.
- Unit card -> stays on hover; pressing a pokemon docks it as an inspector on the right with Open sheet (today the press opens the sheet straight away).
- Verdict dialog -> a results screen over the field: result, line, rewards, both teams, Best as a podium, Stay and look, Leave battle.

New (proposal): the gold damage trail; the inspector step before the sheet.
Kept: countdown, status line, leave confirmation.

inv-raid.text:
RAID: same components as Battle

Moved:
- The boss's wide meter -> a banner at top centre with the boss's face, name (Frenzy for a Noble) and its share left; the raid's title sits above the name.
- Your side's meter -> a plate bottom left with its standing count.
- Leave -> bottom right.

Kept: the Noble's burst ring, red marks and stagger stars; an Alpha's copies.
Proposals (Show proposals): a kind badge, ticks at 3/4, 1/2, 1/4, a callout when one is passed.
Not drawn: a party list or a timer, which the game has not got.

inv-motion.text: MOTION: every tile is a proposal. Today the game has fades of 250ms (dialogs, popovers), toast in and out, cell notes, the ball land and shake, bar width transitions and the button press. Reduce motion stays as it is: everything cut to a moment.

inv-phone.text: PHONE: these three still show today's phone layouts. They get the same redesign pass next, following the desktop boards once those are agreed.

inv-box.text:
BOXES: every element of catches-list (index, heading, rail, actions, box-form, released), CatchGrid, CatchBox and CatchCard has a place

Moved:
- Dialog (64rem) -> the full sheet (76rem), the size of the catch sheet, so six squares a row get room.
- Summary line, New box and Select -> the top line; Done replaces both while selecting.
- Rail: Find a box, boxes (grip, swatch, name, count; Default first, built in), phone + chip, New box form, Let go today, the hint line and 'n of 32 boxes used' -> kept as the left rail.
- Box heading (swatch, name, Built in, fill line, Add pokemon, the ⋯ menu: rename, colour, lay out, close up, move all, delete, and their inline questions) -> one line over the box.
- Search, This box / All boxes, sort, order -> one row under it; the range line and the slot-order note share the line below.
- Selection strip (n selected, Move to, Favorite, Lock, Release twice with its candy price, Clear, held-back line) -> a green bar under the title.
- Squares: sprite, level, HP bar, egg walk bar, star and lock left, shiny and shadow right, fainted wash, picked tick, gaps dashed, box tag in All boxes.
- Hover card (CatchCard) and its verb; long-press on a phone; drag onto a box or a gap; Put here; Pick all.
- Dock: Close and the press note.

Kept as they are: the let-go list (opened from the rail), the Add to picker.
Proposals (Show proposals): a fill meter under each made box in the rail; a Picked tray under the box while selecting.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-picker.text:
CATCH PICKER and ITEM DIALOGS: no board of their own

- The catch picker (catch-picker/*) is the same grid, search row, squares and hover card as the Boxes board, inside a 44rem dialog: the box switcher stays the search row's lead, the multi-pick confirm and Pick none sit in the dock, the second-press confirm under the box.
- Bottle Cap, Ability Patch and Increase PP keep their layout (sprite, the choice, the status line, Use and Cancel) on the restyled primitives: radio rows become option cards like the move picker's.
- MovePicker rows take the catch sheet's move card look (type stripe, category, name).

inv-bag.text:
BAG: every element of InventoryList, ItemGrid, CandyGrid, ItemCard and BagHint has a place

Moved:
- Dialog (44rem) -> a 59rem sheet, so the pockets and a 6-wide tray sit side by side on every desktop.
- Pocket tabs (All, each kind the bag holds in ITEM_TYPE_ORDER with its count, a divider, Candies) -> a left rail of pockets, each with its colour; the open pocket is still remembered per device.
- 'About the bag' hint -> a ? at the sheet's top right.
- Search (type:berry is:usable), the 6×5 tray with count pills and gold price notes, empty squares, the pager -> the pocket's column, the pocket's name and stack count over it.
- Candies: the gold tray, no search, no pager, every pile.
- Press: a usable item opens Use it on, a relic its raid, an Escape Rope climbs out; then the teach, PP, Bottle Cap and Ability Patch dialogs, as today.
- Tooltip on pointing, as today.
- Dock: Close.

Proposal (Show proposals): pressing an item docks it on the right (art, count, pocket, price, description, the pokemon it would help) with its verb, Use it on…, in place of going straight to the picker. The sheet widens to 76rem for it.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-dex.text:
POKEDEX: every element of PokedexTab, PokedexGrid and SpeciesFormsDialog has a place

Moved:
- Dialog (44rem) -> a 59rem sheet with a rail, the size of the bag.
- Count badges (seen, caught, of total) -> two number tiles at the top of the rail.
- Region chips (name, seen/total, caught bar; a press turns to its first number) -> the rail, one row each.
- Find (a number turns to its page and rings it gold; a name finds only ones met) and All / Caught / Missing -> one row over the grid.
- Pager (earlier, '#001 – #030 · Kanto', later) -> between the find row and the grid.
- Grid (6×5, base forms only; unmet, seen as a silhouette, caught; still sprites; #NNN in the corner; every square a button) -> kept, larger squares.
- A press: forms first when the species has more than one, then the entry, as today. The forms dialog keeps its grid, 'n of m found' and Close.
- Dock: Close.

New: a key under the grid (caught, seen, not met).
Proposals (Show proposals): a mark on squares that have forms; a gold star on a region with everything caught.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-entry.text:
DEX ENTRY: every element of dex-entry-dialog (index, body) has a place

Moved:
- Bar (previous, '#NNN Name' or ???, category, types, seen and caught, next, close) -> a hero header like the catch sheet's, steps either side of the name.
- Portrait with its Regular / Shiny and ♂ / ♀ toggles -> the left column's stage.
- Height, weight, candy, hatch steps -> four tiles under it.
- Evolution line (stages, arrows with the method, other stages open their entry, its hint) -> a card filling the left column.
- Base stats (six bars, total), Abilities (plain, hidden, signature) and Habitat (lairs, biomes with hours, towns; extinct and none fallbacks) -> the centre column, each a card with its hint.
- Moves (Level, Machines, Egg tabs; level, type, category, name, power and PP; empty notes) -> the right column, scrolling in its card.
- Unmet: ??? and 'Meet this pokemon to fill in its entry.' across the two right columns; the silhouette stays.

'Show unmet' on the board only switches the board's example.
Dropped: nothing.

PHONE for all four: one column, the rail as a row of chips over the grid (as the box does today), cards stacked; drawn after these are agreed.

inv-counters.text:
OVERWORLD COUNTERS: every element of StopDialog, PortalDialog, GymSeatDialog, HoneyTreeDialog and NestDialog has a place

Moved:
- Nameplate face (28px) -> a 76px stage in a hero band under the nameplate, washed in the place's colour, why: a person or a landmark should be readable.
- Greeting or landmark line (description) -> the speech bubble beside the stage.
- Terms (price, you carry, levels, bring, wins, stakes, often) -> one chip strip under the hero, tones as today.
- Line-up (Stop, Seat) -> a framed 3-wide tray in ember or tide wash; the Factory's crate is the gold one, pick count in its label.
- Town list (Portal) -> cards with a biome square, search above, pager under.
- Width default -> wide (44rem).
- Dock: Walk on left, the action right with its cost pill, as today.

Kept: spent and bare panels, the house rule, the unseen note, every disabled rule.
New (proposal): a one-line dock note on what happens next.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-safari.text:
SAFARI: every element of SafariDialog has a place

Moved:
- Name box (held items, flight, ability, caught before) -> a glass plate top left of the field, caught-before as a gold pill.
- Run, Throw, Bag tiles -> same three, same order, restyled as buttons that squash; Throw keeps the ball in hand and its count.
- Bag -> the 6-wide square tray in place of the tiles, with Never mind under it.
- Caught: Walk on and Have a look; fled or exited: Walk on alone.
- Width default -> wide (44rem).

Kept: the 250px field held in height, the ball standing in for the pokemon while it rocks, the textbox as the live status, insistent while throwing.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-worldmap.text:
WORLD MAP: every element of WorldMapDialog has a place

Moved:
- Sky chip -> a Ground / Sky segmented control at the top of a new left rail, why: it chooses what the map shows.
- Key popover -> the rail's list (you, town, each biome in view).
- Worth a walk line -> rows in the rail while Sky is on.
- Steering hint (bar) -> a ? at the sheet's top right.
- Width wide -> rail (59rem).

Kept: the canvas and how it draws, drag and keys, coordinates plate bottom left, pan pad bottom right, Close.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-talk.text:
NPC VISIT AND FORMS: every element of the conversation frame and the forms has a place

Moved:
- Speaker portrait (28px in the nameplate) -> a 64px stage in a hero band; the speaker's line is the bubble beside it.
- Say: Next and Walk on, as today.
- Ask: options as option cards (or the list with a have-line and an action when list is set); refused rows greyed with their reason.
- Shop: Buy / Sell as a segmented control over the item tray.
- Pick a team: the party strip first, then Your pokemon / Saved teams, then the box; Join in the dock.
- Teach a move: terms, the new move in a tide card, known moves as move cards, the one to forget struck in ember.
- Width by form: say and ask wide, shop and team rail, teach wide.

Kept: PickOne, PickedRow, the pickers' filters and reasons, insistent forms, the waiting dots.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-login.text:
TITLE SCREEN AND SIGN IN: every element of LoginForm and the signed-out page has a place

Moved:
- Name and tagline -> a tinted header on the card.
- Sign in / Create tabs -> a full-width segmented control.
- Passkey and provider buttons -> a two-column grid under an 'or' divider.
- Code step: note, code field, trust box, Continue, swap and Back, as today.

Kept: theme toggle top right, error status above the button, passkey on Sign in only.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-commandbar.text:
COMMAND BAR AND ANNOUNCEMENTS: every element has a place

Moved:
- Announcement banners -> gold cards with a 28px close, same place (top centre).
- Command bar -> a sheet near the top, answer above the input, suggestions under it.

Kept: the / mark, Tab, arrows, Enter, Escape, active row, hints on the right of each row, dismissal remembered per device.
New (proposal): a one-line key hint under the list.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-settings.text:
SETTINGS: every element of SettingsTab, SecurityPane and CreditsCard has a place

Moved:
- Sections (tabs on a phone, a side list from md) -> a rail with a colour square each, About after a divider, Development in a dev build only; the open one is still remembered.
- Radio rows (language, clock, board edge, box width) -> option cards.
- Switches, sliders and key rows keep their rows inside one card per pane.
- Width wide -> rail (59rem).

Kept: every setting, its description and its storage; the controls note; passkeys, authenticator and backup codes; the credits cards.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-profile.text:
PROFILE: every element of ProfileTab, ProfileDialog, EditProfileDialog, TeamsCard, AwardsCard, BattleHistory and BuddyCard has a place

Moved:
- Trainer card (face, name, title badge, gold, place) -> the hero band's left half; the buddy card -> its right half.
- Actions menu -> the hero's right edge (own: Edit profile, Add a friend, Sign out; visited: Battle, friend action, Block).
- Section list (Record, Social, Market with counts) -> the rail.
- Visited Battles / Awards tabs -> a segmented control, no rail.
- Edit dialog -> wide, the trainer sprites as a tray.
- Width broad -> sheet (76rem); visited wide -> the same sheet.

Kept: filters, replays, claims, awards tabs, teams and their limits.
Friends, Requests, Trades, Bids and Selling panes: see the Profile friends board.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-quests.text:
QUESTS: every element of QuestBoard, QuestCard, RotationCard and LockedCard has a place

Moved:
- Today and This week -> the first two rail rows (Rotating).
- Chain accordion -> rail rows (Chains) with a leaf count for ready and claimed / total; the open chain fills the pane.
- Asked of anybody and Done -> rail rows (Other).
- Hint -> a ? at the top right.
- Width wide -> rail (59rem).

Kept: requirement tiles with bars, the Pays line, Claim and Claimed, locked cards, re-read on reopen.
New (proposal): a progress track at the pane's head (claimed over total).
Dropped: nothing.

inv-news.text:
NEWS: every element of NewsTab and ReleasePage has a place

Moved:
- Release list -> a rail with the Latest badge and the brought line.
- Release page (a nested dialog) -> the pane beside the rail; a phone keeps the sheet.
- Width wide -> rail (59rem).

Kept: the empty note, the markdown rendering, Close.
New (proposal): the rail is paged at LIST_PAGE, since releases grow with every update.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-profilesocial.text:
PROFILE PANES (FRIENDS, REQUESTS, TRADES, BIDS, SELLING): every element has a place

Moved:
- Rows (FriendEntry, trades, lots) -> the row card: face, two lines, state pill, buttons right.
- Pending / Settled -> a segmented control at the pane's head.
- Add a friend -> the pane's top right.

Kept: search, Blocked list, the second press on Accept and Take back, the Answer flow, collect, take back, pagers.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-trades.text:
TRADES: every element of TradeOfferDialog and the answer picker has a place

Moved:
- Your pick and their pick -> two framed sides facing each other with a swap mark.
- Gold select -> a segmented control with the amount beside it and its note.
- Answer with -> the catch picker at rail width, reasons shown on the squares.

Kept: named ask versus their pick, the limits, Send and Never mind.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-auctions.text:
AUCTIONS: every element of AuctionTab, the bid dialog and AuctionDialog has a place

Moved:
- Gold badge -> a left rail.
- Items and Pokemon grids keep their order, 8 wide; the hover card carries seller, bid, View and the bid or collect actions.
- Sell mode replaces the board as today; the dock holds Back to the board.
- Bid and List dialogs -> narrow sheets with a lot row on top.
- Width wide -> rail (59rem).

Kept: search with price terms, refusals, the two-step listing.
New (proposal): Everything / Items / Pokemon filters in the rail.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-raids.text:
RAIDS: every element of RaidsTab, RaidLobby and RaidDialog has a place

Moved:
- Lair rows -> a 2-column grid of lair cards; Invited stays above with an ember wash.
- Boss card -> a field floor under the sprite; the chart rows keep Weak to, Resists and Immune.
- Trainer rows keep your row first and highlighted.
- Lair dialog -> a hero band with the sleeping boss on the floor.

Kept: next-window countdown, search, watching list, notices, every dock action.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-duels.text:
DUELS: every element of DuelsTab, DuelLobby and DuelRulesDialog has a place

Moved:
- List -> the same sections in a narrower sheet.
- Lobby: rules stay as chips, the seats stay on the field with VS; the dock carries the status line.
- Rules dialog -> the fields in a two-column grid, bans as switches.

Kept: Ready stamp, Take the seat, watching faces, blocker messages.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-friends.text:
FRIENDS: every element of AddFriendDialog and LobbyInviteDialog has a place

Moved:
- Your code -> a tinted card with Copy.
- Role select -> a segmented control.

Kept: lookup by code, View and Add, invite by code, the friends list with Invited and Already here.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-gifts.text:
GIFTS AND NOTIFICATIONS: every element of GiftsTab and NotificationsTab has a place

Moved:
- Gift tabs -> a segmented control with counts.
- Gift hover card keeps the record preview, reason and Take or Meet.
- Notification rows -> cards with a colour edge by kind; sender as a face and name.
- Gifts wide -> rail (59rem).

Kept: empty notes, viewOnly and ledger modes, pager.
New (proposal): none.
Dropped: nothing.
